description: China's money-market and government-bond benchmark rates. `series: "shibor"` returns the Shanghai Interbank Offered Rate across all 8 tenors (overnight through 1-year) — the latest 11:00-Beijing-time fixing plus up to `days` of daily history. `series: "yield_curve"` returns the China Government Bond yield curve: the dated 1-year/10-year benchmark series (IMF SDDS disclosure) plus CFETS's real-time quoted-yield curve across every actively-traded CGB maturity (~1 month to ~50 years). Answers "current SHIBOR rates", "China's 10-year government bond yield", "China yield curve history". Keyless, sourced live from the China Foreign Exchange Trade System / National Interbank Funding Center.

days.description: (shibor only) How many calendar days of history to request, 1-365 (default 30).

periods.description: (yield_curve only) How many daily rows of the 1Y/10Y benchmark history to return, 1-60 (default 20).
